name: Ugly People
overview: Scripture affirms that every person is created in the image of God, wonderfully made by His hand, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and Psalms 139:13-14. True value is not found in outward appearance, for beauty is fleeting and can be deceptive, but in a heart that fears the Lord, which is praiseworthy above all (Proverbs 31:30). The Bible warns against valuing external beauty without discretion, emphasizing the importance of godly character over physical attractiveness (Proverbs 11:22). Thus, the concept of 'ugly people' must be understood in light of God’s design and the eternal worth He imparts to every individual.
